top_event: US-Iran War + Strait of Hormuz Closure + Coordinated FX Interventions
summary: 7 CAT-5 events: US-Iran war ~6 months with Hormuz closed by Tehran (US naval blockade, missile threats, 'crushing economic operation'), coordinated US/Japan/Korea FX interventions ($34-59B yen, won 9-mo high, rupee near record lows), 5th US bank failure 2026 (Tioga-Franklin Aug 21), energy shock (Brent ~$89, stockpiles diminishing, IEA confirms supply chain disruption), China property 5-yr downward spiral, largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history (WHO IHR Emergency Committee Aug 18), Africa debt crisis (Egypt $1.8B IMF, Senegal on brink)
